<thought>Based on the observed monoisotopic m/z 224.1201 (likely the [M+H]⁺ ion), the neutral molecular mass is approximately 223.113 Da. A plausible formula that matches this mass within typical MS error is C₁₂H₁₅O₄. This fits the required format CxHyOzX (with no additional element, X is omitted).</thought>
<final_answer>C12H15O4</final_answer>
